criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 8 July 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 8 July 2029 (36 months after Closing).

Identifies that the Redcliffe Technologies Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($275,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Flags that the disclosure letter is inconsistent with the material contract on change of control.
Lists the Redcliffe Technologies Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
